主要内容: On January 25, 2021, Nicholas Financial, Inc. announced the opening of a new branch office in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The company issued a press release detailing the expansion, which is part of its strategy to increase its market presence. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. This event is reported under Item 8.01 of the Form 8-K, indicating it is an 'Other Events' disclosure. The information provided is not deemed 'filed' under Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference into any other filing unless explicitly stated. The expansion is a strategic move to enhance the company's operations in the region.
